PullRequest.Title: Track customization migration hint and migration actions
PullRequest.Body:
<!-- Thank you for submitting a Pull Request. Please:

  https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/wiki/How-to-Contribute#pull-requests
* Associate an issue with the Pull Request.
* Ensure that the code is up-to-date with the `main` branch.

Scenarios.Scenario: Sending a chat request when customization migration hints are enabled
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing migration-hint provider runs in parallel with hook and instruction collection before request preparation proceeds. The refactored hintComputed telemetry performs the same per-category logging as before; the new hintShown call executes synchronously after collection and before later request setup, but is a constant-size event and is not awaited.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Compute customization migration hint by inspecting existing customization state through the pre-existing provider.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One provider invocation per eligible request; effective frequency is zero by default, once per chat session in Once mode, or once per request in Always mode.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same provider invocation and wait occurred before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The provider is part of the existing request-context Promise.all and must finish before request setup continues.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Emit customization migration assessment and hint-shown telemetry through configured appenders.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Assessment remains one event per returned category as before; the diff adds one constant-size hintShown event per displayed hint.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Assessment events were emitted directly by ChatService; no separate hintShown event was emitted.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Event cleaning and appender dispatch are synchronous, while IPC/network delivery is fire-and-forget and not awaited by the chat request.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Displayed hints, gated by the experimental setting and existing per-session shown state; category count only affects the unchanged assessment loop.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Hint collection is one promise within the per-request Promise.all. There is no new parallel fan-out; telemetry appenders receive one additional hintShown event per actually displayed hint.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Default mode is Never. Once mode uses model state to suppress subsequent hints in a session, and workspace dismissal suppresses future provider calls; Always intentionally permits one event per request. The diff does not alter these gates.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: request orchestration, gates, event counts, and appender behavior are explicit in the traced code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Appender cost varies by platform and telemetry configuration, but payloads are fixed-size and delivery is not awaited.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The only added request-path work is one bounded, fire-and-forget telemetry event when a hint is actually shown.

Scenarios.Scenario: Opening and navigating the customization migration dashboard
Scenarios.CriticalPath: A click or explicit navigation emits one action/impression telemetry event synchronously, then performs the same dashboard preparation, render, layout, and focus scheduling as before.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Emit pageShown, navigation, retry, skip/include, destination, review, view, and dismissal telemetry.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One or two constant-size events per explicit user navigation/action; category rendering does not emit per-row impressions.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: These dashboard interactions performed their UI/storage actions without the new telemetry event.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Synchronous event preparation precedes the existing render/action, but remote delivery is not awaited.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Refresh migration information and candidate state when opening a dashboard without a category.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing refresh per programmatic dashboard open that lacks a category.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same refresh occurred before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The existing refresh is awaited before showing the dashboard.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: User navigation/action count; migration category and candidate cardinality do not multiply the added telemetry calls.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Navigation is UI-event driven and serialized on the renderer event loop. No new queue, burst, or per-row asynchronous work is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The editor reuses its existing migration candidate state and dashboard instance; the diff adds no cache and does not invalidate existing state. Telemetry events are intentionally not coalesced because each represents a distinct action/impression.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: every added call is directly attached to an explicit action or page transition.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact telemetry appender overhead is platform-dependent, but each payload is bounded and action-frequency limited.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Added work is bounded per interaction and does not scale with rendered candidates or activity rows.

Scenarios.Scenario: Executing file or MCP customization migrations
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing confirmation and filesystem/service migration must complete first. The diff emits one migrationClicked event before starting and one migrationCompleted event after the aggregate result, without awaiting telemetry, then continues existing activity recording and UI refresh.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Copy/move/delete selected customization files or migrate selected MCP server configuration.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Existing work scales with selected files/servers; grouping and migration behavior are unchanged by the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same selected-item migration operations occurred before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Migration I/O is the operation's existing critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Emit aggregate migration-start and migration-completion telemetry containing counts.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly two constant-size events per confirmed migration attempt, independent of selected-item count.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No migration start/completion telemetry was emitted.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Local event processing is synchronous, but IPC/network delivery is fire-and-forget and not awaited.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of explicit migration attempts; selected candidate count only changes numeric fields, not event count or payload size materially.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Migration concurrency and sequencing are unchanged. Telemetry adds no tasks per file/server and no new concurrent migration work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No new caching or retained collection is introduced. Existing candidate state and migration results retain their previous lifecycle.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: calls are outside all per-item loops and use aggregate counts.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Telemetry appender overhead varies, but the added cardinality remains two events per whole operation.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff adds fixed aggregate telemetry around an already much more expensive user-initiated operation.

Scenarios.Scenario: Clicking review or dismiss on a chat migration hint
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The action emits one fixed-size telemetry event, then follows the existing editor-open path or workspace storage write. The telemetry call is not awaited.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One event per user click when the hint target argument is present.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The action opened the editor or stored dismissal without this telemetry event.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Only synchronous event preparation precedes the command's existing work; delivery is fire-and-forget.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Persist the workspace-scoped dismissal through IStorageService.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing storage operation per dismiss click.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same dismissal state was stored before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The existing synchronous store call remains on the command path.

Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One event per explicit click; no burst or item-level fan-out.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The workspace-scoped dismissal acts as the existing negative gate for later hint computation; the diff preserves it.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: command handlers and ordering are explicit.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Negligible prevalence uncertainty because cardinality is directly bounded by user actions.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. One bounded telemetry event does not materially amplify the existing action path.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance review of all 11 changed files and all diff hunks. The PR centralizes existing assessment telemetry and adds fixed-size impression/action/outcome events. Added calls are gated per displayed hint, explicit UI action, page transition, or whole migration operation; none fan out by candidate/file count, retain unbounded state, add awaited I/O, or move heavyweight work onto startup/render paths. No valid performance finding or regression-fix record was identified.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
